resources.string: Car audio (Bluetooth hands-free)
Use car audio
Run the full assistant on this phone and talk through your car\'s Bluetooth hands-free microphone and speakers. Off by default; applies to this phone only.
Pair and connect the phone to your car for phone calls (hands-free / HFP). A car connected only for music (A2DP) is not enough. Live Ninja never scans for or pairs devices.
This is not Android Auto and nothing appears on the car\'s screen. Wake-word listening is paused while car audio is on, so start conversations from Live Ninja on your phone while safely parked.
A phone call, another app taking the audio, or the car disconnecting ends the conversation. It never restarts by itself; start it again when you are ready.
Turning this on asks for the microphone and, on Android 12 and newer, Nearby devices (Bluetooth) permission. If you decline, car audio stays off.
Off. Conversations use the phone\'s normal audio.
On. A Bluetooth hands-free device is available.
On, but a required permission was removed. Car audio conversations cannot start until you allow it again.
A conversation is starting or running. End it before changing car audio.
Car audio is set on each phone. View this phone\'s settings to change it.
On, but no Bluetooth car or headset with a microphone is connected. Connect the car for phone calls in Android\'s Bluetooth settings, then start the conversation.
On, but a phone call or calling app is using call audio right now.
On, but car audio is not ready right now.
Allow permissions
Car audio turned on. Start a conversation from the app when you are safely parked.
Car audio turned off.
Can\'t change car audio while a conversation is starting or running. End the conversation first.
Car audio can only be changed while viewing this phone.
Permission not granted, so car audio stays off. Turn it on again to retry, or allow access in Android\'s app permission settings.
Permissions allowed.
Permission still not allowed. Car audio conversations cannot start until it is.
Car audio mode: Bluetooth hands-free call audio
Car audio mode: permission needed (Settings → Microphone)
Car audio mode: no hands-free car connected
Car audio mode: not ready right now
Car audio conversation
Shown while a conversation session uses car audio mode.
Car audio session
Car audio session in progress. Tap End to finish.
Ending.
End
